page.content:
Captain of the Enterprise in The Original Series.

How James T. Kirk connects

  • Creator: William Shatner — William Shatner originated Captain Kirk.
  • Series: Star Trek: The Original Series — TOS is Kirk's command of the Enterprise.
  • Faction: Enterprise crew — Kirk captains the TOS Enterprise crew.
  • Character: Spock — Kirk's command is built on his bond with Spock.

What is James T. Kirk?

James T. Kirk is the Iowa-born captain whose instinct, bluff, and loyalty to Spock and McCoy set the first command style of Starfleet on screen.

Key threads lead to William Shatner, Star Trek: The Original Series, Enterprise crew and Spock.
